title: Installation Jobs Permit Filings: Safety-Glazing Schedule Adder
content:
**Safety-glazing schedule adder — permit filings on Installation Jobs**

The permit administration fee of a permitted **Installation Jobs** record carries a safety-glazing adder. It follows the openings that the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract the job installs orders with tempered or laminated glass by change order, which the building department checks against the safety-glazing schedule. The adder is added to the fee.

| Openings ordered with tempered or laminated glass by change order | Safety-glazing adder |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | $35.00 |
| 1 to 3 | $20.00 |
| none | nothing |

## How the openings are counted

The count is the total of the openings affected on the window contract's change orders for tempered glass, plus the total of the openings affected on its change orders for laminated glass. Openings ordered with other kinds of change are not counted.

## Cases (hypothetical change orders)

| Change orders on the window contract | Openings counted | Adder |
|---|---|---|
| one tempered-glass change order for 2 openings and one laminated-glass change order for 2 openings | 4 | $35.00 |
| one tempered-glass change order for 3 openings | 3 | $20.00 |
| one laminated-glass change order for 1 opening | 1 | $20.00 |
| only change orders of other kinds | 0 | nothing |
